<?php
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): float { echo "GET;"; return NAN; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-nan"); }
};
set_error_handler(function (int $level, string $message, string $file, int $line) use (&$reader): bool {
    echo $level === 2 ? "WARN;" : "BAD_LEVEL;";
    echo $message, ";";
    echo isset($reader->value) ? "BAD_GUARD;" : "GUARD;";
    $reader = null;
    return true;
});
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->$selector); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious() === null ? "NO_PREVIOUS;" : "BAD_PREVIOUS;"; }
restore_error_handler();
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function floatReviewBadRight() { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): float {
        global $reader;
        echo "GET;";
        $reader = null;
        return "0.5";
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-float"); }
};
$selector = "gone";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ?? floatReviewBadRight(); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getLine(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "gone" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
